ns2:course.label: Comparative Vertebrate Morphol
ns2:course.description: Comparative structure, evolution, and classification of chordate animals emphasizing vertebrates. Strong attention to relationships of fossils to present animals. Function of parts, their evolution, and some developmental aspects. Lab involves dissection of vertebrates. Lecture and Laboratory. Same as ANTH 434. Prerequisite: IB 202, IB 302, or consent of instructor.
